protocol.geometry_rule: Absolute pair distance/median positive gap,cap20;two signed learned scalar biases initialized0. Finite global attention,not physical edges.
protocol.loss: Unmodified ordinary patch State RMSE;no temporal auxiliary objective
protocol.data: Exact stored Queue-shaped control plans/inputs/teachers/core masks/cell exposure;no new labels
protocol.initialization: All shared state tensor bytes equal original control initialization;new coefficients zero. Additional constructor RNG consumed after shared initialization,training has no dropout/random sampling beyond frozen plan.
protocol.controls: A97 NN and perseed queue models,A112 strong channel reused,not refit
protocol.checkpoint: Ordinary pure cal State every4epochs,first maximum
protocol.hybrid: Fixed new mean speed + existing strong channel flow;no additional weight search
protocol.primary: Keep strong_channel unless candidate cal gain>=.0005 and minimum regime gain>=-.001;best eligible cal score,pure mean tie preference
protocol.assessment: Viewed old public assessment,read after both fits and all choices seal
protocol.future_scope: Registered before fits;public research,prior studies may have viewed dates,not final/private

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights
